basics.name: Eero Salmela
basics.label: Senior Software Developer, Partner
basics.summary:
Eero is a senior full-stack developer, integration specialist and data engineer with 20 years of experience building business-critical digital services and data platforms.

His work ranges from an electricity transmission system operator's open-data and grid-operations tools to a global software company's internal analytics platform and enterprise integrations connecting core business systems.

He moves comfortably between backend, frontend, data and infrastructure, combining strong expertise in Azure and Microsoft technologies with TypeScript, Python, Kubernetes and modern DevOps practices.
basics.x-tagline: Great software ties everything together – the people using it, the data, the integrations and the systems underneath.
basics.x-hobbies: Enjoys nature and outdoor activities as well as a variety of sports.

projects.name: Open Data & Grid Operations Tools
projects.description: Designed and developed an open data platform, along with multiple internal applications supporting key grid operations, including signal testing, power grid disturbance analysis, and production curtailment message handling.

projects.name: Smart City Platform
projects.description: Evaluated MVP-stage smart city solutions and implemented CI/CD pipelines to support infrastructure deployment and scalability during early-stage development.

projects.name: Internal Data & Analytics Platform
projects.description: Part of the client's internal Data & Analytics Platform team, responsible for developing a data warehouse that delivers enriched customer survey data across all of the company's products for internal use via a REST API. Also managed GDPR compliance and integration of data from multiple internal sources.

projects.name: Real estate asset management data platform
projects.description: Contributed to the initial development of an intelligent real estate asset management platform designed to minimize vacant spaces and maximize returns across real estate portfolios. Part of the founding team responsible for delivering the first production-ready versions of the platform.

projects.name: Internal Chatbot
projects.description: Designed and implemented an internal chatbot for HR and IT support using Azure Bot Framework, helping employees quickly access support resources and automate common service requests.

projects.name: ERP & Automation
projects.description: Extended the lifespan of the legacy ERP system by modernizing key components and supported its integration with a newly implemented robotic warehouse and automation systems. This work was carried out during the company's transition to a significantly larger production facility.

projects.name: IoT Reporting
projects.description: Built a customer-facing reporting solution using the ThingWorx IoT platform, enabling the client to deliver real-time data insights and visualizations as part of its IoT service offering to customers.

projects.name: Master data validation notifications
projects.description: Responsible for designing and implementing a custom email notification system aimed at improving data integrity in the MDS (Master Data Services) environment. The solution automatically notifies users when they attempt to modify an MDS entity that either fails validation rules or results in the creation of a duplicate entity, helping to reduce errors and ensure consistency across the system.

projects.name: Integration platform
projects.description: Oversaw the maintenance and development of a critical integration platform supporting day-to-day business operations. The integration platform handled more than 100 unique integrations.

projects.name: CMS product new version
projects.description: Part of the team responsible for designing and implementing a new version of the CMS product, with a focus on modernizing the architecture, enhancing usability, and improving overall system performance.

projects.name: BizTalk system integrations
projects.description: Responsible for designing and implementing system integrations using BizTalk, enabling reliable data exchange and process automation across multiple enterprise applications.

projects.name: Public-facing websites for government and environmental agencies
projects.description: Part of the team responsible for designing and implementing multiple public-facing websites for the ministry and related government and environmental agencies using a commercial CMS platform. Contributed to the delivery of accessible, user-friendly, and reliable digital services for government and environmental agencies.

projects.name: Internet and extranet sites
projects.description: Responsible for designing and implementing both internet and extranet sites for the agency using a commercial CMS platform, supporting secure and user-centric digital services for the agency.

projects.name: Internet and intranet sites
projects.description: Part of the team responsible for designing and implementing the city's internet and intranet sites using a commercial CMS platform, enhancing digital communication for both internal staff and public users in the city.

projects.name: Grain trading web portal
projects.description: Part of the team responsible for designing and implementing the client's grain trading web portal, providing farmers and buyers with tools to manage transactions, access market data, and communicate efficiently.

projects.name: CRM and ERP integrations
projects.description: Part of the team responsible for implementing system integrations between Microsoft Dynamics CRM and Dynamics AX and other enterprise applications, ensuring reliable data exchange and streamlined operations.

projects.name: Customer data integrations and CRM migration
projects.description: Responsible for designing and implementing customer data integrations between the CRM system and various other internal systems. Also developed specialized software used to cleanse and standardize customer data in legacy systems, ensuring data quality prior to the CRM migration.

projects.name: Population data query portal
projects.description: Member of the team responsible for implementing a population data query service, a large-scale, high-availability web portal. Also responsible for setting up a new production environment to support a hardware and operating system upgrade, ensuring continued system stability and performance.
